# Third-party test fixtures

The ADF documents under this directory come from the projects listed below. They are used as
conversion fixtures only; no third-party source code was copied into this repository.

The `.json` files are unmodified except that they were reformatted as minified JSON with LF line
endings to keep the repository small. Every `*.expected.md` file was produced by this repository's
own converter, not by the upstream projects.

## jira-adf-converter

- Directory: `jira-adf-converter/`
- Source: <https://github.com/rgonek/jira-adf-converter>, `testdata/`
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Robert Gonek

## atlas_doc_parser

- Directory: `atlas-doc-parser/`
- Source: <https://github.com/MacHu-GWU/atlas_doc_parser-project>, `tests/adf_samples/`
- License: MIT, Copyright 2023 Sanhe Hu
